scheme: Shetmal Taran Karj Yojana (MSAMB pledge loan)
crops: Tur, moong, urad, soybean, sunflower, chana, paddy, safflower, jowar, bajra, maize, wheat, turmeric, rajma, cashew, raisins, areca (NOT onion)
benefit: Loan up to 75% of value (valued at lower of market price or MSP) for 180 days at 6%; then 8% for next 6 months and 12% thereafter; storage, supervision and insurance by APMC free; also against MSWC/CWC warehouse receipts
eligibility: Producer farmers only (traders' produce not accepted)
how_to_apply: Deposit produce in participating APMC godown and apply at the APMC (circular & form on MSAMB site)

scheme: e-NWR pledge finance + Credit Guarantee Scheme (CGS-NPF)
crops: Any notified agri/horti produce stored in WDRA-registered warehouses
benefit: Rs 1,000 cr guarantee corpus so banks lend against electronic negotiable warehouse receipts; lets farmer hold stock instead of distress sale
eligibility: Farmers (incl. small/marginal), FPOs, cooperatives, MSMEs, traders using WDRA-registered warehouses
how_to_apply: Deposit in WDRA-registered warehouse, obtain e-NWR, apply for pledge loan at scheduled/cooperative bank

scheme: Post-harvest interest subvention on loans against NWR (MISS/KCC)
crops: All crops stored in WDRA-accredited warehouses
benefit: Concessional 7% p.a. (effective 4% with prompt repayment on crop loans) extended up to 6 months post-harvest against negotiable warehouse receipts; MISS limit raised Rs 3 -> 5 lakh in Budget 2025
eligibility: Small & marginal farmers holding Kisan Credit Card

scheme: PM-AASHA: Price Support Scheme (PSS) at MSP
crops: Pulses (tur, urad, masur up to 100% of state output through 2028-29; others 25%), oilseeds (soybean etc.), copra
benefit: Central agencies NAFED/NCCF buy FAQ produce at MSP from pre-registered farmers; payment by DBT
eligibility: Pre-registered farmers with FAQ produce in notified procurement window
how_to_apply: Register on NAFED e-Samridhi / NCCF e-Samyukti or MH state agency centres when window opens (MH soybean 2025-26: reg. from 30-10-2025, purchase 15-11-2025..12-02-2026)
period: Continued for 15th FC cycle to 2025-26; 100% tur/urad/masur for 4 years from 2025

scheme: Price Deficit Payment Scheme / Bhavantar (Madhya Pradesh only - NOT available in Maharashtra)
benefit: Pays difference between MSP and state model rate to registered MP farmers who sell in MP mandis
how_to_apply: MP e-Uparjan portal/CSC/PACS - not applicable to Maharashtra farmers

benefit: Rebate up to 50% on storage charges for farmers (also SC/ST & tribal-area farmers); 25% of space reserved for farmers; NWR usable for bank pledge loans
how_to_apply: Deposit at nearest MSWC warehouse centre; take receipt to bank for pledge loan

benefit: Past rounds: Rs 200/qtl (sales 01-11..31-12-2018, max 200 qtl) and Rs 350/qtl (sales 01-02..31-03-2023, max 200 qtl). No 2026 round found as of 2026-10-02
eligibility: Onion growers with 7/12 crop record and APMC/private market/NAFED sale receipts in the notified window
how_to_apply: Apply via APMC with sale patti, 7/12 and bank details when GR is issued

benefit: Rs 6,000/year in three Rs 2,000 instalments by DBT (23rd instalment 20-06-2026); not linked to sale timing
eligibility: Eligible landholding farmer families (Aadhaar-seeded bank account)

benefit: Land-revenue concession, crop-loan restructuring, stay on recovery of agri loans, pump power-bill concession, no disconnection - reduces cash pressure to sell immediately after harvest
how_to_apply: Automatic via district administration/banks; panchnamas by collectors

crops: All traded commodities in integrated mandis
benefit: Online bidding across a larger buyer pool, sale proceeds direct to bank; 1,656 mandis, 1.80 cr farmers registered (Feb 2026)
eligibility: Any farmer selling in an e-NAM-integrated APMC
how_to_apply: Register on enam.gov.in / mobile app or at the APMC gate

benefit: Find trucks/transport aggregators for primary & secondary movement of produce to better markets
